(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte; 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai, 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte. Reference Translation (provided): So bitter is it that death is little more. But in order to treat of the good that there I found, I will tell of the other things that I have seen there.

**Interpretation Lock – one bullet per source line**
- **Line 7 “Tant' è amara che poco è più morte;”** *Locked Meaning*: The (implicit) referent is **so bitter** that **death is only a little more bitter** than it. - Predicate‑argument structure: **[it] è amara** (copular predicate “is bitter”) + comparative clause **che [poco] è [più] morte** (“that death is a little more [bitter]”). - Modifier scope: the adverb **poco** limits the degree of the comparative **più**, signalling a *slight* excess of bitterness on the part of death.
- **Line 8 “ma per trattare del ben ch'i' vi trovai,”** *Locked Meaning*: **But** (contrast) the speaker’s purpose is **to treat/discuss the good that I found there**. - Predicate‑argument structure: purpose preposition **per** + infinitive **trattare** (to treat) taking the complement **del ben** (“of the good”). - Relative clause **ch'i' vi trovai** modifies **ben**: subject **i'** (“I”), locative adverb **vi** (“there”), verb **trovai** (past‑historic “found”).
- **Line 9 “dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte.”** *Locked Meaning*: The speaker **will tell** (future) **about the other things that I have seen there**. - Predicate‑argument structure: main verb **dirò** (“I will say”) with prepositional complement **de l'altre cose** (“about the other things”). - Relative clause **ch'i' v' ho scorte** modifies **cose**: subject **i'** (“I”), locative **v'** (“there”), auxiliary **ho** + past participle **scorte** (“seen”).
